decimals: Send price, latitude, longitude as numbers on write. Expect decimal strings on Event responses.

viewerFlags.privateStranger: getEvent returns 404 — no payload, no CTAs

statusHandling.403: Show forbidden; do not retry as another verb; do not treat as 404
statusHandling.404: Opaque — missing OR private OR not joinable. Never prompt request access
statusHandling.422: Show message / bind details; do not navigate as success

timeoutAndOffline.retry: Show offline; retry on user action when online

refetch.afterJoinOrSwitch: listEventTeamParticipants for target event_team_id only — not full event tree
refetch.afterLeave: getEvent and/or listEvents as needed (may lose private visibility)
refetch.afterRenameTeam: docs/api/v1 EventTeams — local label or getEventTeam; do not refetch participants

invitePicker: listFriendships.accepted → other user per row − listEventParticipants − listEventInvitations → createEventInvitations { user_ids }. No /invitees.

crossLinks.friendships: docs/api/v1 — accepted friends for invite picker
